question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Broad
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Broad"** means having an ample distance from side to side; wide. (चौड़ा)

 
 
• **Example: **The road was **broad **enough to accommodate four lanes of traffic.
 
 
 
• **"Wide" **refers to having a great extent from side to side. (विस्तृत)
 
 
• **Example: **The river was too **wide **to cross without a bridge.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Broad' **is **'Wide'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Particular **(विशेष): Specific or distinct.

 
 
• **Example:** She wanted that **particular **dress for her birthday.
 
 
 
• **Exact **(सटीक): Precise, correct in all details.
 
 
• **Example: **He gave the **exact **measurements for the project.
 
 
 
• **Small** (छोटा): Of a size that is less than normal or usual.
 
 
• **Example:** She lives in a **small **apartment in the city.
 
 

32:Tc44,

योग्य उत्तर आहे: **पर्याय 1**.</p
